identification: Three small framed pen-and-wash (ink and watercolour on buff/tan paper) studies of Tasmanian colonial houses by Cheyne Purdue (Hobart-born Tasmanian painter and muralist, painted the 1988 Sheffield murals, John Glover Prize finalist 2006, now teaches as Cheyne Purdue-Pozzo): 'Egmont Cottage, Westbury, Tasmania', 'Entally House, Hadspen, Tasmania' and 'Forth, Tasmania'. Each about 18 x 25 cm, matching timber frames with cream mats. Look like originals (loose ink line, wash over), though they are souvenir-style topographic pieces.

entries.note: Cheyne Purdue framed watercolour 'Cradle Mountain Glade' 75 x 49 cm, a larger single work. Paid locally (Armitage): what we might pay, NOT a resale price. Database record only.
